XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Polisi Darlledu
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Broadcasting Policy

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 3. A yw'r Comisiwn wedi cael cyngor annibynnol ynghylch a yw ei bolisi darlledu yn deg, yn gymesur ac yn cael ei gymhwyso'n gyson? OQ64743
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 3. Has the Commission obtained independent advice on whether its broadcasting policy is fair, proportionate and consistently applied? OQ64743

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you. The Commission’s broadcasting policy drew on a report by an independent adviser, which examined the Senedd’s historical position, looked at five other legislatures and considered relevant policy principles. I recently agreed that this policy could be reviewed. In September, Commissioners were asked to consider four options. It was determined that further consultation was required between the Commission and party groups, and this is now under way, with officials already having met or briefed most party groups.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Roedd polisi darlledu'r Comisiwn yn pwyso ar adroddiad gan gynghorydd annibynnol, a archwiliodd safbwynt y Senedd yn y gorffennol, ac edrychodd ar bum deddfwrfa arall ac ystyried egwyddorion polisi perthnasol. Cytunais yn ddiweddar y gellid adolygu'r polisi hwn. Ym mis Medi, gofynnwyd i'r Comisiynwyr ystyried pedwar opsiwn. Penderfynwyd bod angen ymgynghori pellach rhwng y Comisiwn a grwpiau'r pleidiau, ac mae hyn bellach ar y gweill, gyda swyddogion eisoes wedi cyfarfod â'r rhan fwyaf o grwpiau'r pleidiau neu wedi eu briffio.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch. GB News is still excluded from the Senedd's internal television screens, and the justification was that comments made were contrary to the Parliament's values. However, the very broadcasting protocol itself was developed by an unnamed independent adviser to the Senedd Commission. So, what are the values of this adviser and on what political spectrum do they lie? The fact is the inclusion of Sky News as a commercial broadcaster undercuts the rule of allowing only public service broadcasters on the internal Senedd television screens. GB News is also a licensed news and current affairs broadcaster like Sky News, and its programmes cover issues affecting people across Wales, including perspectives that challenge the Welsh Government's policies.

So, while I recognise the Commission's responsibility to maintain appropriate standards, these standards must be applied fairly, consistently and proportionately. So, could we have discussions on this sooner rather than later, and can we all have an opinion on this, so that we can get GB News back where it belongs on our internal tv screens?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Mae GB News yn dal i gael ei wahardd o sgriniau teledu mewnol y Senedd, a'r cyfiawnhad oedd bod sylwadau a wnaed yn groes i werthoedd y Senedd. Fodd bynnag, datblygwyd y protocol darlledu ei hun gan gynghorydd annibynnol di-enw i Gomisiwn y Senedd. Felly, beth yw gwerthoedd y cynghorydd hwn ac ar ba sbectrwm gwleidyddol y mae'n sefyll? Y gwir yw bod cynnwys Sky News fel darlledwr masnachol yn tanseilio'r rheol o ganiatáu darlledwyr gwasanaeth cyhoeddus yn unig ar sgriniau teledu mewnol y Senedd. Mae GB News hefyd yn ddarlledwr newyddion a materion cyfoes trwyddedig fel Sky News, ac mae ei raglenni'n ymdrin â materion sy'n effeithio ar bobl ledled Cymru, gan gynnwys safbwyntiau sy'n herio polisïau Llywodraeth Cymru.

Felly, er fy mod yn cydnabod cyfrifoldeb y Comisiwn i gynnal safonau priodol, rhaid cymhwyso'r safonau hyn yn deg, yn gyson ac yn gymesur. Felly, a gawn ni drafodaethau ar hyn yn gynt yn hytrach nag yn hwyrach, ac a gawn ni i gyd farn ar hyn, fel y gallwn gael GB News yn ôl lle mae'n perthyn ar ein sgriniau teledu mewnol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
So, Catherine, we are keeping consistency here that this is appearing in every Commissioner's questions, but simply to say the independent adviser's report remained part of the evidence that was also presented to Commissioners. That included, by the way, comparison with Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Westminster and Victoria and other parliaments. But the framework we're now using is one that looks at transparent, objective criteria rather than judgments about individual broadcasters' particular viewpoints and so on.

The original policy, by the way, that stands at the moment to amend what channels were available on internal tvs was agreed by the majority of the previous Commissioners, and in answer to your point, it ensures access to channels that have public service obligations and also provides one additional news channel, Sky News, to ensure plurality of news stations. You asked whether we're getting on with it: yes, as I said in my opening remarks, we're already engaging with political groups.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Felly, Catherine, rydym yn cynnal cysondeb yma fod hyn yn ymddangos yng nghwestiynau pob Comisiynydd, ond os caf ddweud yn syml fod adroddiad y cynghorydd annibynnol wedi parhau'n rhan o'r dystiolaeth a gyflwynwyd i Gomisiynwyr hefyd. Roedd honno'n cynnwys, gyda llaw, cymhariaeth ag Awstralia, Canada, Seland Newydd, San Steffan a Victoria a seneddau eraill. Ond mae'r fframwaith rydym ni'n ei ddefnyddio nawr yn un sy'n edrych ar feini prawf tryloyw, gwrthrychol yn hytrach na dyfarniadau am safbwyntiau penodol darlledwyr unigol ac yn y blaen.

Cytunwyd ar y polisi gwreiddiol, gyda llaw, sy'n sefyll ar hyn o bryd i ddiwygio pa sianeli oedd ar gael ar setiau teledu mewnol gan y mwyafrif o'r Comisiynwyr blaenorol, ac mewn ymateb i'ch pwynt, mae'n sicrhau mynediad at sianeli sydd â rhwymedigaethau gwasanaeth cyhoeddus a hefyd yn darparu un sianel newyddion ychwanegol, Sky News, i sicrhau lluosogrwydd o orsafoedd newyddion. Fe wnaethoch chi ofyn a ydym yn bwrw ymlaen â hyn: ydym, fel y dywedais yn fy sylwadau agoriadol, rydym eisoes yn ymgysylltu â'r grwpiau gwleidyddol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: And I rise again, with the greatest of respect to the Member, who is persistent and consistent at the very least. But I am perplexed, and I wonder if the Member is listening. No. I am perplexed why the Member keeps raising this issue. So, let's just be clear: GB News is repeatedly embroiled in serious controversies. Last June—[Interruption.] Dirprwy Lywydd, may I carry on in some silence, please? Diolch. Just last week, a GB News presenter apologised in court and agreed to pay substantial damages to a UK politician. Meanwhile, Ofcom is investigating the channel. Ofcom is investigating the channel following more than 12,000 complaints about a guest—
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Ac rwy'n codi eto, gyda'r parch mwyaf at yr Aelod, sy'n ddyfal ac yn gyson o leiaf. Ond mae'n peri penbleth i mi, ac rwy'n meddwl tybed a yw'r Aelod yn gwrando. Na. Mae'n peri penbleth i mi pam y mae'r Aelod yn parhau i godi'r mater hwn. Felly, gadewch inni fod yn glir: mae GB News wedi bod ynghlwm dro ar ôl tro wrth anghydfodau difrifol. Fis Mehefin diwethaf—[Torri ar draws.] Ddirprwy Lywydd, a gaf i dawelwch i barhau, os gwelwch yn dda? Diolch. Yr wythnos diwethaf, ymddiheurodd cyflwynydd GB News yn y llys a chytunodd i dalu iawndal sylweddol i wleidydd o'r DU. Yn y cyfamser, mae Ofcom yn ymchwilio i'r sianel. Mae Ofcom yn ymchwilio i'r sianel yn dilyn mwy na 12,000 o gwynion am westai—

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Jane, have you got a question for the Llywydd?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Jane, a oes gennych chi gwestiwn i'r Llywydd?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I have, I have. But, Dirprwy Lywydd, I've been interrupted, so I'm coming to that, thank you. Twelve thousand complaints about a guest appearing to associate Pride, the organisation, with child sexual exploitation and bestiality. And once again, we are here about GB News.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Oes, mae. Ond Ddirprwy Lywydd, torrwyd ar fy nhraws, felly rwy'n dod at hynny, diolch. Cafwyd 12,000 o gwynion am westai a oedd i'w weld yn cysylltu Pride, y sefydliad, â chamfanteisio'n rhywiol ar blant a milgydiad. Ac unwaith eto, rydym ni yma'n siarad am GB News.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Can we have the question for the Llywydd, please?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: A gawn ni'r cwestiwn i'r Llywydd, os gwelwch yn dda?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: My question to the Llywydd is: will the Llywydd agree that broadcasting GB News would be at odds with the principles of respect, dignity and integrity that should underpin the Senedd? Diolch yn fawr iawn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fy nghwestiwn i'r Llywydd yw: a yw'r Llywydd yn cytuno y byddai darlledu GB News yn groes i egwyddorion parch, urddas ac uniondeb a ddylai fod yn sylfaen i'r Senedd? Diolch yn fawr iawn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
The Member tempts me to pre-empt where the review is going and also to pre-empt the views of individual Commissioners. There are four Commissioners that sit with me in deliberation on this and I think, out of respect for them, I have to wait to see the views of Members being put forward. They'll have heard the views put forward by all Members and will come to, I'm sure, a good and fair and reasonable decision on the four options that have been put in front of them.

By the way, just to remind Members, one of those options is, of course, focusing on the primary use of parliamentary monitors on the estate, which is to inform Members of what is going on in this place. However, there are also alternative views that say that Members should have ready access to breaking news and so on. We're comparing with other Parliaments as well as to what is currently done there. So, all views are genuinely welcomed.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Mae'r Aelod yn fy nhemtio i achub y blaen ar ble mae'r adolygiad yn mynd a hefyd i achub y blaen ar farn Comisiynwyr unigol. Mae pedwar Comisiynydd yn ystyried hyn gyda mi, ac allan o barch atynt hwy, rhaid imi aros i weld safbwyntiau'r Aelodau'n cael eu cyflwyno. Byddant wedi clywed y safbwyntiau a gyflwynwyd gan yr holl Aelodau a byddant yn dod i benderfyniad da a theg a rhesymol, rwy'n siŵr, ar y pedwar opsiwn a roddwyd o'u blaenau.

Gyda llaw, i atgoffa'r Aelodau, un o'r opsiynau hynny yw canolbwyntio ar y prif ddefnydd o fonitorau seneddol ar yr ystad, sef hysbysu Aelodau am yr hyn sy'n digwydd yn y lle hwn. Fodd bynnag, mae yna safbwyntiau amgen hefyd sy'n dweud y dylai Aelodau gael mynediad parod at newyddion sy'n torri ac yn y blaen. Rydym yn cymharu â Seneddau eraill hefyd ynglŷn â'r hyn sy'n cael ei wneud yno ar hyn o bryd. Felly, mae croeso go iawn i bob safbwynt.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Hyfforddiant Diogelu
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Safeguarding Training

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 4. Pa ystyriaeth y mae'r Comisiwn wedi'i roi i gyflwyno hyfforddiant diogelu gorfodol ar gyfer yr holl Aelodau o'r Senedd a'u staff cymorth? OQ64741
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 4. What consideration has the Commission given to introducing mandatory safeguarding training for all Members of the Senedd and their support staff? OQ64741

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch. The Commission cannot formally mandate training for Members, who are of course elected office holders, or their staff, who are employed by those individual Members. However, the Commission treats learning or briefings that inform and protect Members, their staff and the Senedd from legal, regulatory or reputational risk as necessary and recommend them as essential.

We provide training and support to help Members understand their responsibilities and ensure their staff are appropriately trained, and we continue to promote participation through accessible, appropriately sequenced provision. Participation by Members and Member support staff is vital. It has been particularly helpful in the past when party groups have required their Members to attend particular training, while employing Members may require—and, depending on the subject, may be responsible for ensuring—that their staff complete appropriate training.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Ni all y Comisiwn orfodi hyfforddiant ffurfiol i Aelodau, sydd wrth gwrs yn ddeiliaid swyddi etholedig, na'u staff, sy'n cael eu cyflogi gan yr Aelodau unigol hynny. Fodd bynnag, mae'r Comisiwn yn trin dysgu neu sesiynau briffio sy'n hysbysu ac yn diogelu Aelodau, eu staff a'r Senedd rhag risg gyfreithiol neu reoleiddiol neu risg i enw da yn ôl yr angen ac yn eu hargymell fel rhai hanfodol.

Rydym yn darparu hyfforddiant a chefnogaeth i helpu Aelodau i ddeall eu cyfrifoldebau a sicrhau bod eu staff wedi'u hyfforddi'n briodol, ac rydym yn parhau i hyrwyddo cyfranogiad trwy ddarpariaeth hygyrch, wedi'i dilyniannu'n briodol. Mae cyfranogiad Aelodau a staff cymorth Aelodau yn hanfodol. Mae wedi bod yn arbennig o ddefnyddiol yn y gorffennol pan fo grwpiau'r pleidiau wedi gofyn i'w haelodau fynychu hyfforddiant penodol, tra gall defnyddio Aelodau alw am—ac yn dibynnu ar y pwnc, gall fod yn gyfrifol am sicrhau—bod eu staff yn cwblhau hyfforddiant priodol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Lywydd. The Commission's own guidance makes clear that while safeguarding is everyone's responsibility, it has designated safeguarding officers who act as a central point of contact for managing concerns. This is standard practice. However, individual Members are responsible for safeguarding arrangements within their own offices, and although the Commission advises Members and their staff to mirror its safeguarding policy, there really isn't an equivalent safeguarding structure, as it were, or central point of contact for Members themselves. You mentioned political groups, Llywydd, but what consideration has the Commission seriously given to how safeguarding arrangements for Members and their support staff could be strengthened, including through that mandatory training I mentioned and clearer procedures to ensure that everyone knows how to raise concerns and that both the people we represent and those working to represent them are properly protected?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Lywydd. Mae canllawiau'r Comisiwn ei hun yn dweud yn glir, er bod diogelu'n gyfrifoldeb i bawb, fod ganddo swyddogion diogelu wedi'u dynodi sy'n gweithredu fel pwynt cyswllt canolog ar gyfer rheoli pryderon. Mae hyn yn arfer safonol. Fodd bynnag, Aelodau unigol sy'n gyfrifol am drefniadau diogelu yn eu swyddfeydd eu hunain, ac er bod y Comisiwn yn cynghori Aelodau a'u staff i adlewyrchu ei bolisi diogelu, nid oes strwythur diogelu cyfatebol mewn gwirionedd na phwynt cyswllt canolog i'r Aelodau eu hunain. Fe wnaethoch chi sôn am grwpiau gwleidyddol, Lywydd, ond pa ystyriaeth y mae'r Comisiwn wedi'i roi o ddifrif i sut y gellid cryfhau trefniadau diogelu ar gyfer Aelodau a'u staff cymorth, gan gynnwys drwy'r hyfforddiant gorfodol a grybwyllais a gweithdrefnau cliriach i sicrhau bod pawb yn gwybod sut i godi pryderon a bod y bobl gynrychiolwn a'r rhai sy'n gweithio i'w cynrychioli yn cael eu diogelu'n briodol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch yn fawr. I think I've mentioned the point in terms of mandatory training. Members are elected office holders, so we cannot formally mandate training for Members, but you rightly raise the issue of the role of group offices. In the interests of their Members and their staff, we've stressed how critical we see these opportunities that are provided. If it is of help to Members, once again, I can happily write out to Members and business managers to explain to them how they can direct their Members to safeguarding training.

The safeguarding policy statement is on the hwb online and includes, by the way, matters such as appointing a safeguarding lead, safer recruitment, secure record keeping, reporting arrangements, safe physical and digital environments, and much more as well. So, we're providing every possible opportunity that there can be, both for Members' benefit and for their staff's benefit. I'll take away and consider, Sera, from the question whether it would be helpful to write out once again to business managers and Members to remind them of how they can do this.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch yn fawr. Rwy'n credu fy mod wedi sôn am y pwynt ynghylch hyfforddiant gorfodol. Mae Aelodau'n ddeiliaid swyddi etholedig, felly ni allwn orfodi hyfforddiant ar gyfer Aelodau yn ffurfiol, ond rydych chi'n iawn i godi mater rôl swyddfeydd y grwpiau. Er budd eu Haelodau a'u staff, rydym wedi pwysleisio pa mor hanfodol yr ystyriwn y cyfleoedd a ddarperir. Os yw o gymorth i Aelodau, unwaith eto, rwy'n hapus i ysgrifennu at Aelodau a rheolwyr busnes i esbonio iddynt sut y gallant gyfeirio eu Haelodau at hyfforddiant diogelu.

Mae'r datganiad polisi diogelu ar yr hwb ar-lein, a gyda llaw, mae'n cynnwys materion fel penodi arweinydd diogelu, recriwtio mwy diogel, cadw cofnodion diogel, trefniadau adrodd, amgylcheddau ffisegol a digidol diogel, a llawer mwy hefyd. Felly, rydym yn darparu pob cyfle posibl, er budd yr Aelodau ac er budd eu staff. Yn sgil y cwestiwn, Sera, fe wnaf ystyried a fyddai'n ddefnyddiol ysgrifennu unwaith eto at reolwyr busnes ac Aelodau i'w hatgoffa sut y gallant wneud hyn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: As Sera clearly points out, Welsh Government policy is very clear that safeguarding is everyone's responsibility. So, if safeguarding training is expected across so many other areas of public service, why should those seeking help from their elected representatives expect anything less? Therefore, does the Commission agree that safeguarding training is essential not only to help Members and their staff recognise the signs of abuse, neglect or exploitation, but also to give the public confidence that they will be treated safely, fairly and consistently by any Member, as elected representatives, and their staff, of course, too?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fel y mae Sera'n nodi'n glir, mae polisi Llywodraeth Cymru yn glir iawn fod diogelu'n gyfrifoldeb i bawb. Felly, os disgwylir hyfforddiant diogelu ar draws cymaint o feysydd eraill o wasanaeth cyhoeddus, pam y dylai'r rhai sy'n ceisio cymorth gan eu cynrychiolwyr etholedig ddisgwyl unrhyw beth yn llai na hynny? Felly, a yw'r Comisiwn yn cytuno bod hyfforddiant diogelu yn hanfodol nid yn unig i helpu Aelodau a'u staff i adnabod arwyddion camdriniaeth, esgeulustod neu ecsbloetio, ond hefyd i roi hyder i'r cyhoedd y byddant yn cael eu trin yn ddiogel, yn deg ac yn gyson gan unrhyw Aelod, fel cynrychiolwyr etholedig, a'u staff hefyd wrth gwrs?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Yes, we've stressed—I stressed in my opening remarks—how we consider that this training that we offer is vital. It really is. And it's also vital for the protection of the individual Members as well, because they know that if they've undertaken the training, they are better protected themselves, and so are their staff. And also the public then can have confidence. But, again, I come back to the point here: we can do a lot through business managers, we can do a lot through individual Members. We are making this very easily accessible to Members, but perhaps I could stress how critical this training is, to then appeal to all Members and business managers to take it back to their groups and encourage their Members to do it.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rydym wedi pwysleisio—fe bwysleisiais i yn fy sylwadau agoriadol—sut rydym yn ystyried bod yr hyfforddiant a gynigiwn yn hanfodol. Mae'n wir. Ac mae hefyd yn hanfodol ar gyfer diogelu'r Aelodau unigol hefyd, oherwydd maent yn gwybod os ydynt wedi gwneud yr hyfforddiant, eu bod wedi'u diogelu'n well eu hunain, a'u staff hefyd. A gall y cyhoedd fod â hyder wedyn. Ond unwaith eto, rwy'n dod yn ôl at y pwynt: gallwn wneud llawer trwy reolwyr busnes, gallwn wneud llawer trwy Aelodau unigol. Rydym yn gwneud hyn yn hawdd iawn i Aelodau, ond efallai y caf bwysleisio pa mor hanfodol yw'r hyfforddiant hwn, ac apelio wedyn ar yr holl Aelodau a rheolwyr busnes i fynd ag ef yn ôl at eu grwpiau ac annog eu Haelodau i'w wneud.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Gwaith Adnewyddu yn Nhŷ Hywel
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Tŷ Hywel Renovations

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 5. A wnaiff y Comisiwn nodi costau'r gofod swyddfa dros dro i staff yn ystod y gwaith adnewyddu yn Nhŷ Hywel? OQ64763
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 5. Will the Commission set out the costs of the temporary office space for staff during the Tŷ Hywel renovations? OQ64763

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr, Janet, for your question. The Commission is currently in discussion with landlords in the Cardiff Bay area to secure suitable temporary accommodation while the refurbishment of Tŷ Hywel takes place. Clearly, there will be costs involved. These include rent, fitting out the offices, service charges, utilities, and any costs associated with returning the buildings at the end of leases. Those costs are still being negotiated, so I'm not in a position to give you a precise figure at this point in time, but I think it's important to point out here that moving Members and staff out of Tŷ Hywel will allow for refurbishment to be completed much more quickly, and that brings significant savings as well. In fact, all the options we're currently considering are expected to be at least cost neutral compared with keeping Members in Tŷ Hywel while work takes place. So, I want to reassure you, Janet, that we're looking carefully at the costs, with value for money very much at the heart of our considerations.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch yn fawr am eich cwestiwn, Janet. Ar hyn o bryd mae'r Comisiwn mewn trafodaethau gyda landlordiaid yn ardal Bae Caerdydd i sicrhau llety dros dro addas tra bod gwaith adnewyddu Tŷ Hywel yn digwydd. Yn amlwg, bydd costau ynghlwm wrth hynny. Mae'r rhain yn cynnwys rhent, gwaith gosod y swyddfeydd, taliadau gwasanaeth, cyfleustodau, ac unrhyw gostau sy'n gysylltiedig â dychwelyd yr adeiladau ar ddiwedd lesoedd. Mae'r costau hynny'n dal i gael eu negodi, felly nid wyf mewn sefyllfa i roi ffigur manwl gywir i chi ar hyn o bryd, ond credaf ei bod yn bwysig nodi yma y bydd symud Aelodau a staff allan o Dŷ Hywel yn caniatáu i'r gwaith adnewyddu gael ei gwblhau'n gyflymach o lawer, ac mae hynny'n sicrhau arbedion sylweddol hefyd. Mewn gwirionedd, disgwylir i'r holl opsiynau rydym yn eu hystyried ar hyn o bryd fod yn niwtral o ran cost fan lleiaf o'i gymharu â chadw Aelodau yn Nhŷ Hywel tra bod y gwaith yn digwydd. Felly, rwyf am eich sicrhau, Janet, ein bod yn edrych yn ofalus ar y costau, gyda gwerth am arian yn ganolog yn ein hystyriaethau.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. Over 500 Commission staff work in Tŷ Hywel, and then, of course, you do have the 96 Members and our members of staff. The refurbishment of Tŷ Hywel is set to last approximately three years. We've only got three and a half years left of this current term. These refurbishments, complete, are set to cost around £42 million, but with the relocation and decanting of this high number of staff and Members, it is bound to be a very costly exercise. You could even have duplication. You could have a situation where you're keeping all the lights and all the heating going in this building whilst it's being refurbed, and we're paying those heating costs—a duplication of costs. This at a time when people are facing so many increased costs of living themselves within their families. As a previous proud Conservative Commissioner, it is true, and it should be on record, that I opposed such a massive spend of taxpayers' money, because I believe that it is taxpayers' money that's being spent, and it is vital that we are as transparent as possible.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Mae dros 500 o staff y Comisiwn yn gweithio yn Nhŷ Hywel, ac yna, wrth gwrs, mae gennych y 96 Aelod a'n haelodau staff. Disgwylir i'r gwaith o adnewyddu Tŷ Hywel bara tua thair blynedd. Dim ond tair blynedd a hanner sydd gennym ar ôl o'r tymor presennol hwn. Disgwylir i'r gwaith adnewyddu, wedi'i gwblhau, gostio tua £42 miliwn, ond gydag adleoli a dadleoli'r nifer uchel hwn o staff ac Aelodau, mae'n sicr y bydd yn ymarfer costus iawn. Gallech hyd yn oed gael dyblygu. Gallech gael sefyllfa lle rydych chi'n cadw'r holl oleuadau a'r holl wres i fynd yn yr adeilad hwn tra'i fod yn cael ei adnewyddu, a byddwn yn talu'r costau gwresogi hynny—yn dyblygu costau. A hyn ar adeg pan fo pobl yn wynebu cymaint o gostau byw eu hunain yn eu teuluoedd. Fel cyn Gomisiynydd Ceidwadol balch, mae'n wir, a dylai fod wedi'i gofnodi, fy mod wedi gwrthwynebu gwariant mor enfawr o arian trethdalwyr, oherwydd rwy'n credu mai arian trethdalwyr sy'n cael ei wario, ac mae'n hanfodol ein bod mor dryloyw â phosibl.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Can we have the question, please?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: A gawn ni'r cwestiwn, os gwelwch yn dda?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Yes, it’s coming right now. Will the Commissioner commit to providing a complete and transparent breakdown of these ever-increasing costings as the plans progress? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Cewch, mae'n dod nawr. A wnaiff y Comisiynydd ymrwymo i ddarparu dadansoddiad cyflawn a thryloyw o'r costau cynyddol hyn wrth i'r cynlluniau fynd rhagddynt? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Janet, for your supplementary question, and I appreciate the importance of keeping costs to a minimum, particularly when we're talking about temporary accommodation. I think, in my initial answer, I did state that what we currently expect is for it to be at least cost neutral, if we were to stay in Tŷ Hywel or to move out, because, obviously, the timescale of the project would be reduced because contractors could get on with the work. So, that's certainly under consideration at the moment. And whilst we're still in commercially sensitive negotiations on the precise costs, I want to assure you that it's about delivering the project most efficiently, minimising disruption and securing the best possible value for public money. And all those details will be available in due course, once those negotiations have been finalised.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch am eich cwestiwn atodol, Janet, ac rwy'n gwerthfawrogi pwysigrwydd cadw costau mor isel â phosibl, yn enwedig pan fyddwn yn siarad am adeilad dros dro. Yn fy ateb cychwynnol, rwy'n credu fy mod wedi dweud mai'r hyn a ddisgwyliwn ar hyn o bryd yw iddo fod yn niwtral o ran cost fan lleiaf, pe baem yn aros yn Nhŷ Hywel neu'n symud allan, oherwydd, yn amlwg, byddai amserlen y prosiect yn fyrrach oherwydd gallai contractwyr barhau â'r gwaith. Felly, mae hynny'n sicr yn cael ei ystyried ar hyn o bryd. Ac er ein bod yn dal i fod mewn trafodaethau masnachol sensitif ar yr union gostau, rwyf am eich sicrhau ei fod yn ymwneud â chyflawni'r prosiect yn fwyaf effeithlon, gan leihau aflonyddwch a sicrhau'r gwerth gorau posibl am arian cyhoeddus. A bydd yr holl fanylion hynny ar gael maes o law, pan fydd y trafodaethau hynny wedi'u cwblhau.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Firstly, I should declare an interest in so far as I've spent over 30 years working in the commercial property market.

I fully understand that a decision needs to be made on the future of Tŷ Hywel, and that during the sixth Senedd, under the previous Welsh Government, the current proposal for Bay 32 was agreed by the Commission to be significantly cheaper than the only other alternative. Doing nothing is not an option and, unfortunately, it looks like it will fall on Members of this Senedd to deal with the issues around Tŷ Hywel's lease expiring. Therefore, I think that it is important that every Member recognises the potential disruption coming next summer, based on the current programme, as our offices are moved offsite for the rest of the Senedd term.

So, before the final decision is made, can more detailed proposals be presented to Members on the temporary relocation plan, especially on how our new offices will be arranged, and how they will link with this Siambr, so that the implications for our work here can be fully understood?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Yn gyntaf, dylwn ddatgan buddiant i'r graddau fy mod wedi treulio dros 30 mlynedd yn gweithio yn y farchnad eiddo masnachol.

Rwy'n deall yn iawn fod angen gwneud penderfyniad ar ddyfodol Tŷ Hywel, ac yn ystod y chweched Senedd, o dan Lywodraeth Cymru flaenorol, cytunodd y Comisiwn fod y cynnig presennol ar gyfer Bae 32 gryn dipyn yn rhatach na'r unig ddewis arall. Nid yw gwneud dim yn opsiwn ac yn anffodus, mae'n edrych yn debyg mai Aelodau'r Senedd hon fydd yn gorfod delio â'r materion sy'n codi o'r ffaith bod les Tŷ Hywel yn dod i ben. Felly, credaf ei bod yn bwysig fod pob Aelod yn cydnabod yr aflonyddwch posibl sy'n dod yr haf nesaf, yn seiliedig ar y rhaglen bresennol, wrth i'n swyddfeydd gael eu symud oddi ar y safle am weddill tymor y Senedd.

Felly, cyn i'r penderfyniad terfynol gael ei wneud, a ellir cyflwyno cynigion mwy manwl i'r Aelodau ar y cynllun adleoli dros dro, yn enwedig ar y ffordd y caiff ein swyddfeydd newydd eu trefnu, a sut y byddant yn cysylltu â'r Siambr hon, fel y gellir deall y goblygiadau i'n gwaith yma'n llawn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Nick. I think that's a very fair point. I absolutely recognise the concerns that Members will have about the potential disruption to work. The original intention was to keep Members in Tŷ Hywel while the refurbishment took place, precisely to minimise those disruptions. However, having tested the options carefully, it became clear that the risks from noise, vibration, dust and potential delays were simply too great. We could have ended up with far more disruption and much less certainty for Members and for staff.

We're now working to secure high-quality alternative accommodation very close to the Senedd, which will retain the full range of support services that Members need to do their jobs efficiently. Importantly, moving everyone out temporarily will also allow for refurbishment work to progress much more quickly. The savings from that should at least offset the additional accommodation costs and could potentially deliver an overall saving.

A detailed relocation plan is being developed, and I agree with Nick that Members need to understand exactly what those arrangements will mean for them and their staff. Our priority must be to make the transition as smooth as possible, minimise disruption to the work of the Senedd, and ensure that Members can return to a refurbished Tŷ Hywel under the current programme by April 2030.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Nick. Credaf fod hwnnw'n bwynt teg iawn. Rwy'n llwyr gydnabod y pryderon a fydd gan yr Aelodau ynglŷn â'r tarfu posibl ar eu gwaith. Y bwriad gwreiddiol oedd cadw'r Aelodau yn Nhŷ Hywel tra bo'r gwaith adnewyddu'n mynd rhagddo er mwyn lleihau'r tarfu hwnnw. Fodd bynnag, ar ôl profi'r opsiynau'n ofalus, daeth yn amlwg fod y perygl o sŵn, dirgryndod, llwch ac oedi posibl yn ormod. Gallem wynebu llawer mwy o darfu a llawer llai o sicrwydd i'r Aelodau ac i'r staff yn y pen draw.

Rydym yn gweithio nawr i sicrhau adeilad amgen o ansawdd uchel yn agos iawn at y Senedd, a fydd yn cadw'r ystod lawn o wasanaethau cymorth sydd eu hangen ar Aelodau i wneud eu gwaith yn effeithlon. Yn bwysig, bydd symud pawb allan dros dro hefyd yn caniatáu i waith adnewyddu fynd rhagddo'n llawer cyflymach. Dylai'r arbedion o hynny o leiaf wrthbwyso costau ychwanegol yr adeilad, a gallai arwain o bosibl at arbediad cyffredinol.

Mae cynllun adleoli manwl yn cael ei ddatblygu, ac rwy'n cytuno â Nick fod angen i'r Aelodau ddeall beth yn union fydd y trefniadau hynny'n ei olygu iddynt hwy a'u staff. Rhaid inni flaenoriaethu gwneud y cyfnod pontio mor llyfn â phosibl, lleihau'r tarfu ar waith y Senedd, a sicrhau y gall yr Aelodau ddychwelyd i Dŷ Hywel wedi'i adnewyddu o dan y rhaglen bresennol erbyn mis Ebrill 2030.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mannau Manwerthu'r Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Senedd Retail Outlets

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 6. Beth yw proses y Comisiwn ar gyfer penderfynu pa eitemau sydd ar gael i'w gwerthu i'r cyhoedd ym mannau manwerthu'r Senedd? OQ64769
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 6. What is the Commission's process for deciding what is available for sale to the public from Senedd retail outlets? OQ64769

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Commission officials are responsible for deciding what products are available in the Senedd shop. Products stocked are regularly reviewed and updated. Goods for sale in the shop range from, but are not exclusive to, branded souvenirs, local artisan goods, Welsh food and drink, and products that inform and engage on a broad range of topics. A comprehensive review to inform a refreshed shop strategy has been under way since July and has included support from an independent retail consultant. A refreshed shop strategy will go to Commissioners for consideration in the coming months.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Swyddogion y Comisiwn sy'n gyfrifol am benderfynu pa gynhyrchion sydd ar gael yn siop y Senedd. Caiff y cynhyrchion a gaiff eu stocio eu hadolygu a'u diweddaru'n rheolaidd. Mae nwyddau sydd ar werth yn y siop yn amrywio o, ond heb fod yn gyfyngedig i, swfenîrs wedi'u brandio, nwyddau artisan lleol, bwyd a diod o Gymru, a chynhyrchion sy'n darparu gwybodaeth ac yn gysylltiedig ag ystod eang o bynciau. Mae adolygiad cynhwysfawr i lywio strategaeth wedi'i hadnewyddu ar gyfer y siop wedi bod ar y gweill ers mis Gorffennaf ac mae wedi cynnwys cefnogaeth gan ymgynghorydd manwerthu annibynnol. Bydd strategaeth wedi'i hadnewyddu ar gyfer y siop yn dod gerbron y Comisiynwyr i'w hystyried yn y misoedd nesaf.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, Commissioner. In the Welsh Parliament's bookshop, there are several books that promote the immensely harmful trans ideology to children. This is all the more concerning given that the Welsh Government supports children's access to puberty blockers. Children can't be born in the wrong body and they shouldn't be injected with cross-sex hormones. Those two statements should not be controversial. Commissioner, will you have those books removed from the Welsh Parliament's bookshop?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Gomisiynydd. Yn siop lyfrau Senedd Cymru, mae sawl llyfr sy'n hyrwyddo'r ideoleg draws hynod niweidiol i blant. Mae hyn yn fwy annifyr byth o ystyried bod Llywodraeth Cymru yn cefnogi mynediad i blant at feddyginiaeth atal y glasoed. Ni all plant gael eu geni yn y corff anghywir ac ni ddylid eu chwistrellu â hormonau croesrywiol. Ni ddylai'r ddau ddatganiad hwnnw fod yn ddadleuol. Gomisiynydd, a wnewch chi gael gwared ar y llyfrau hynny o siop lyfrau Senedd Cymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Like most parliamentary gift shops, the Senedd shop sells a broad mix of products. We're always looking for ways to improve the gift shop and we welcome Members' and customers' feedback. But the Senedd Commission is also firmly committed to advancing diversity and inclusion, ensuring that the Senedd is welcoming and accessible and representative of the people of Wales. So, it's no surprise that that approach may be reflected in some of the items available for purchase.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fel y rhan fwyaf o siopau anrhegion seneddol, mae siop y Senedd yn gwerthu amrywiaeth eang o gynhyrchion. Rydym bob amser yn chwilio am ffyrdd o wella'r siop anrhegion ac rydym yn croesawu adborth gan Aelodau a chwsmeriaid. Ond mae Comisiwn y Senedd hefyd wedi ymrwymo'n gadarn i hyrwyddo amrywiaeth a chynhwysiant, gan sicrhau bod y Senedd yn groesawgar ac yn hygyrch ac yn cynrychioli pobl Cymru. Felly, nid yw'n syndod y gallai'r ymagwedd honno gael ei hadlewyrchu yn rhai o'r eitemau sydd ar gael i'w prynu.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Dyfodol Tŷ Hywel
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Future of Tŷ Hywel

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 7. A wnaiff y Comisiwn gyhoeddi'r arfarniad o gostau oes gyfan ac opsiynau ar gyfer dyfodol Tŷ Hywel cyn llofnodi unrhyw gontractau rhwymol pellach? OQ64760
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 7. Will the Commission publish the whole-life costs and options appraisal for the future of Tŷ Hywel before signing any further binding contracts? OQ64760

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Steve, for your question. The Commission has undertaken a public, open and competitive procurement process to look at the options available to us when the current lease of Tŷ Hywel comes to an end in 2032. Throughout that process, value for money has been absolutely central to our considerations. We've looked not just at immediate costs, but at the longer term financial implications of each option, including the cost of doing the bare minimum and remaining in Tŷ Hywel under the current arrangements. That work identified the options we're now taking forward as offering the best value for money and at a considerable margin.

The final financial details are still being worked through and will form part of the full business case, which will inform the Commission's decision in December on whether to proceed. I fully appreciate that the Member will want to see those figures, and rightly so. However, we're dealing with commercially sensitive information, and publishing it before contracts are signed could undermine our negotiating position. But I want to reassure Members that we will share that information with them as soon as we're in a position to do so.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch am eich cwestiwn, Steve. Mae'r Comisiwn wedi cynnal proses gaffael gyhoeddus, agored a chystadleuol i edrych ar yr opsiynau sydd ar gael i ni pan ddaw les bresennol Tŷ Hywel i ben yn 2032. Drwy gydol y broses honno, mae gwerth am arian wedi bod yn gwbl ganolog i'n hystyriaethau. Rydym wedi edrych nid yn unig ar gostau uniongyrchol, ond ar oblygiadau ariannol mwy hirdymor pob opsiwn, gan gynnwys cost gwneud cyn lleied â phosibl ac aros yn Nhŷ Hywel o dan y trefniadau presennol. Nododd y gwaith hwnnw yr opsiynau rydym yn bwrw ymlaen â nhw nawr fel y rhai sy'n cynnig y gwerth gorau am arian o gryn dipyn.

Mae'r manylion ariannol terfynol yn dal i gael eu cyfrifo, a byddant yn rhan o'r achos busnes llawn, a fydd yn llywio penderfyniad y Comisiwn ym mis Rhagfyr i weld a ddylid bwrw ymlaen. Rwy'n derbyn yn llwyr y bydd yr Aelod eisiau gweld y ffigurau hynny, ac yn briodol felly. Fodd bynnag, rydym yn delio â gwybodaeth sy'n sensitif yn fasnachol, a gallai ei chyhoeddi cyn llofnodi contractau danseilio ein safbwynt negodi. Ond hoffwn roi sicrwydd i'r Aelodau y byddwn yn rhannu'r wybodaeth honno gyda nhw cyn gynted ag y byddwn mewn sefyllfa i wneud hynny.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you for that. This decision will commit public money for decades, and Members need to see the figures before the Commission commits to the deal. On 8 October, officials told the Finance Committee that the business case uses a 50-year appraisal period. The Commission has also confirmed a right to renew the existing Tŷ Hywel lease for a further 25 years. That option must be tested on a like-for-like basis against the preferred proposal.

Will the Commissioner publish a comparison of the whole-life costs of both options, covering rent, refurbishment, temporary accommodation and maintenance? Will it use the same appraisal period and set out the assumptions made beyond the renewal term? And will Members have sufficient time to scrutinise that comparison before any further binding contractual commitment is made? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Bydd y penderfyniad hwn yn ymrwymo arian cyhoeddus am ddegawdau, ac mae angen i'r Aelodau weld y ffigurau cyn i'r Comisiwn ymrwymo i'r cytundeb. Ar 8 Hydref, dywedodd swyddogion wrth y Pwyllgor Cyllid fod yr achos busnes yn defnyddio cyfnod gwerthuso o 50 mlynedd. Mae'r Comisiwn hefyd wedi cadarnhau hawl i adnewyddu les bresennol Tŷ Hywel am 25 mlynedd arall. Rhaid profi'r opsiwn hwnnw ar sail debyg am debyg yn erbyn y cynnig a ffefrir.

A wnaiff y Comisiynydd gyhoeddi cymhariaeth o gostau oes gyfan y ddau opsiwn, gan gynnwys rhent, gwaith adnewyddu, adeilad dros dro a chynnal a chadw? A fydd yn defnyddio'r un cyfnod gwerthuso ac yn nodi'r rhagdybiaethau a wnaed y tu hwnt i'r tymor adnewyddu? Ac a fydd gan yr Aelodau ddigon o amser i graffu ar y gymhariaeth honno cyn gwneud unrhyw ymrwymiad cytundebol rhwymol pellach? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch for that supplementary question. I fully appreciate that Members want the reassurance that we're getting the best value for public money, and rightly so. It's also important to recognise that doing nothing is not a cost-free option. Staying in Tŷ Hywel under the current arrangements would mean increasing maintenance costs, significant investment in an ageing building, and potential rent increases. 

A full business case will examine all of these costs alongside the proposed development, so that the Commission can make an informed decision in December. It also recognises the importance of transparency, and while we must protect commercially sensitive information during negotiations, we are committed to sharing the financial details with the Finance Committee and Members as soon as we're able to do so.

Diolch am eich cwestiwn atodol. Rwy'n derbyn yn llwyr fod yr Aelodau eisiau'r sicrwydd ein bod yn cael y gwerth gorau am arian cyhoeddus, ac yn briodol felly. Mae hefyd yn bwysig cydnabod nad yw gwneud dim yn opsiwn di-gost. Byddai aros yn Nhŷ Hywel o dan y trefniadau presennol yn golygu costau cynnal a chadw cynyddol, buddsoddiad sylweddol mewn adeilad sy'n heneiddio, a chynnydd posibl mewn rhent.

Bydd achos busnes llawn yn archwilio'r holl gostau hyn ochr yn ochr â'r datblygiad arfaethedig, fel y gall y Comisiwn wneud penderfyniad gwybodus ym mis Rhagfyr. XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Lindsay. Rydym yn cydnabod pa mor bwysig yw gwaith allgymorth cymunedol o ran helpu pobl i ddeall gwaith y Senedd. Yn ystod y flwyddyn ddiwethaf, mae ein tîm addysg ac ymgysylltu â phobl ifanc wedi cyflwyno 29 o sesiynau allgymorth mewn ysgolion, colegau a grwpiau ieuenctid yn yr ardal, gan weithio gyda mwy na 2,000 o bobl ifanc. Mae 11 o sesiynau addysg eraill wedi’u cynnal yma ym Mae Caerdydd, a hynny gyda 337 o bobl ifanc o’r ardal.  

Yn ystod cyfnod yr etholiad, fe wnaethom ni waith allgymorth mewn cymunedau ar draws pob etholaeth, gan ddefnyddio sesiynau sydyn a sgyrsiau mewn lleoliadau cymunedol cyfarwydd i ymgysylltu’n uniongyrchol â phobl leol, ateb eu cwestiynau, a gwella’u dealltwriaeth o rôl y Senedd. Roedd hwn yn cynnwys gweithgarwch ym Mlaenau Gwent Caerffili Rhymni.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Thank you, Lindsay. We recognise how important community outreach work is in supporting and understanding the work of the Senedd. During the last year, our education and youth engagement team has delivered 29 outreach sessions in schools, colleges and youth groups in the area, working with more than 2,000 young people. A further 11 education sessions have been held here in Cardiff Bay, involving 337 young people from that area. 

During the election period, we took our outreach into communities across all constituencies, using pop-ups and conversations in familiar community settings to engage directly with local people, to answer their questions, and to increase understanding of the Senedd's role. This included activity in Blaenau Gwent Caerffili Rhymni.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am yr ateb, Gomisiynydd, ond rydw i’n gwybod bod teimlad cryf ymysg llawer o bobl yn ein cymunedau ni, o Fryn-mawr a Thredegar, hyd at Gaerffili a Rhymni, a Thorfaen hefyd, bod y Senedd yn teimlo fel rhywbeth sydd 'draw yno yng Nghaerdydd' ac yn bell oddi wrth eu bywydau bob dydd. A fydd y Comisiwn yn ymrwymo i drio cynyddu’r nifer o ymweliadau wyneb yn wyneb—achos mae hynny’n bwysig, dwi’n credu—a phrosiectau allgymorth uniongyrchol yn y meysydd lleol hyn, yn lle dibynnu ar ddeunyddiau digidol yn unig, i sicrhau nad yw pobl leol yn teimlo eu bod wedi eu hanghofio?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for the answer, but I know that there is a strong feeling amongst many people in our communities, from Brynmawr and Tredegar, through to Caerphilly and Rhymney, and Torfaen as well, that the Senedd feels like something that is 'over there in Cardiff' and is far removed from their everyday lives. Will the Commission commit to trying to increase the number of face-to-face visits—because they're so important, I believe—and also try to increase the direct outreach projects in these local areas, rather than relying solely on digital material, to ensure that local people do not feel that they've been forgotten?

Gallwn wneud mwy bob amser, wrth gwrs, ac mae ein tîm yn awyddus i fynd allan yno, ac yn gwahodd yr Aelodau hefyd, gan y credwn fod yr Aelodau yma, ar draws y Siambr, yn rhan bwysig o'r broses ymgysylltu honno.
